'''Anything Goes''' is a constructed [[GEMP]] environment on [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play">[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com], GEMP. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009095947/https://play.swccg.com/ Internet Archive].</ref>: every set is legal, the collection is the player's constructed card pool, and the intended deck size is 40–60 cards. Casual tables and AI tables on this instance are meant to default to this environment. [[Open]] stays in the format list for current-virtual constructed play.

Structural checks still apply. A list with both Light and Dark cards, no side, more than one [[Objective]], more than one Starting Effect, uniqueness violations, or unrecognizable cards does not start a game.

Further work for this environment (same-side tables, true any-size lists, empty Reserve / short-hand autoloss, and account-stored settings) is listed on [[GEMP planned features]].

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 40&ndash;60 cards
|}
